The victim was identified as 77-year-old Alice Trench.
Her grandson, Nicholas Trench, was charged with second-degree murder, arson, and abuse of a dead body.
Investigators determined he strangled and beat his grandmother to death, before decapitating her and severing her left arm.
The body parts were placed in a laundry basket inside the shower, where water was left running.
He then set a fire inside the home in an attempt to destroy evidence.
He ultimately pleaded guilty, and in August 22, received a life sentence.
He is currently incarcerated at the Dade Correctional Institution in Homestead, Florida,
with no eligibility for early release except through a governor's pardon or clemency.
